name: Navidrome Music Room
author: MusicMate Contributors
description: Create, share and join synchronized Web or MusicMate listening rooms. Open Website below to manage rooms and QR codes.

enabled.title: Enable Music Room bridge
enabled.description: Send the authorized user list and lease heartbeat to the companion gateway.

navidrome_internal_url.title: Navidrome internal URL
navidrome_internal_url.description: The fixed URL used by the local gateway for OpenSubsonic authentication, for example http://navidrome:4533. Configure the same value on the gateway.

navidrome_public_url.title: Navidrome public URL
navidrome_public_url.description: The HTTPS URL MusicMate clients use for audio, artwork and lyrics.

gateway_internal_url.title: Gateway internal URL
gateway_internal_url.description: Must use an approved local host from the plugin permission list.

gateway_public_url.title: Gateway public URL
gateway_public_url.description: The HTTPS URL MusicMate clients use for room REST and WebSocket traffic.

pairing_token.title: Gateway pairing token
pairing_token.description: Copy this from room-data/secrets/plugin-pairing-token. It is only sent to the configured local gateway.

users.reason: Synchronize only the Navidrome users explicitly authorized by an administrator.

scheduler.reason: Refresh the authorized user list and gateway lease every 30 seconds.

http.reason: Send authenticated user-list heartbeats only to the local Music Room gateway.

kvstore.reason: Store the heartbeat schedule identifier and monotonic sync generation.
